text:
Tara V: uploaded the latest blog draft (link in doc). Need three quick checks: headline, benchmark language, and inbound form mapping for the webinar signups. Can we lock by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Omar H: quick skim  Headline option: 'Inference you can schedule for production'  Slightly clunky; alternative: 'Predictable inference for production teams'. Leaning to alt.

Clare J: product note: prefer the version that mentions "predictable latency and unit cost". Also please add one sentence in the intro about rollout controls (version pinning + canary).

Tara V: will use Clare's phrasing and add the rollout line.

Ben F: benchmarks  please avoid marketing-y multipliers. Suggest we add a boxed callout with reproducible test conditions: 'median generation 220ms, p95 510ms at 1k tokens (NVIDIA A100, batch=8, quantized FP16)'. Put a link to the internal eval dataset.

Ivy P: legal: reword the data line. Can't say "we never see customer inputs". Use: 'Customers can opt for dedicated deployments or VPC peering to meet data residency requirements.' Also attach the compliance checklist in the doc.

Tara V: updated the residency sentence and attached the compliance checklist. Ben  adding the benchmark box now and linking the eval.

Omar H: CTO quote needed. Short option: 'Operational predictability is the difference between prototypes and products.' Good to attribute to Amir?

Clare J: yes attribute to Amir. Also hero image alt should be 'Redwood Inference dashboard'.

Tara V: adding quote and alt text. Webinar CTA draft: 'Register to see a demo, get the full eval, and ask our team questions.' Thoughts on timing?

ops-bot: Ops rec: publish Tue 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 11:00 PT (gives 48h lead time). HubSpot form created: https://hubspot.forms/launch-1824. Hidden fields: campaign=prod_launch_h1, source=blog. Add a checkbox `send_eval=true` to trigger the eval workflow.

Ben F: good. Make the checkbox explicit copy: 'Send me the technical eval (PDF)'.

Ivy P: legal signs off on the revised residency text and the Amir quote. Still require that the eval PDF be uploaded to the legal audit folder and linked before publish.

Tara V: will upload the eval PDF now and update the doc. Inbound mapping to HubSpot: list 'launch_h1_2026', tags ['source:blog','interest:eval'], and workflow to send S3 link when `send_eval=true`. Anna from Ops already set the form.

Omar H: product approves benchmark phrasing as long as details (hardware, batch) are shown.

Ben F: approving content. Minor nit: in the code sample block we should use backticks for the cURL snippet that calls the Redwood API.

Tara V: updated code block formatting and uploaded eval to /legal/audit/launch_eval_1824.pdf.

Ivy P: confirmed artifact present. Legal final sign-off.

Tara V: great. @publish-bot can you schedule CMS publish for 2026-06-15T09:00:00-07:00 and attach webhook to the HubSpot form URL above? Also schedule the webinar per ops-bot.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post "Predictable inference for production teams" set to publish 2026-06-15 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook and eval workflow configured. Webinar scheduled for 2026-06-17 11:00 PDT.

Tara V: final checklist: headline locked, benchmark box + eval attached, legal ok, HubSpot mapping live. If no further comments I'll hit publish on Tuesday. :rocket:
